title: Hide Enlarge Button for Single Window
description: When there is only one window on the canvas, do not show the enlargen button.
summary: Hid Mode's Focus/enlarge control when the canvas has only one window. ModeDockContext now exposes canMaximize from layout window count; the dock tab bar renders Focus only when canMaximize is true (and not on mobile). Stale maximized state clears when the last peer window disappears. Extended existing Mode tests; filtered vitest run passes for the new case and related Focus/maximize coverage.
